_comment: Plugins that ship disabled. Each entry in "plugins" ships DISABLED through every install route: Claude gets enabledPlugins false plus the marketplace in extraKnownMarketplaces; Codex gets the marketplace and the plugin with enabled = false. Adding one is one line: {"plugin": "NAME@MARKETPLACE", "marketplace": "MARKETPLACE", "github": "OWNER/REPO"}. No plugin content is copied; Claude and Codex fetch it from its public marketplace only when the user enables it.
